title: Helping a Younger Sibling with Homework
paragraphs: Every evening, Faisal helps his younger sister with her math homework, even though he studied engineering years ago and finds some of the simple problems surprisingly rusty to explain clearly.
One night, she asks a question about fractions that he cannot immediately answer clearly, and he admits honestly that he needs to look up the method himself before explaining it properly to her.
His sister laughs, pointing out that her older brother, the engineer, needs to check a textbook for fifth-grade homework, and Faisal laughs along, admitting the moment is fairly humbling.

After finding the correct method together, Faisal explains it patiently, and his sister finally understands the concept. He realizes that teaching someone else often reveals gaps in your own understanding first.
